answer: Each agent identity must post a bond recorded in a registry, priced in a scarce token whose pigment is verified at registration. An attacker minting 1,000 fake identities locks 50,000 units, forfeits 90 percent per slashed bond, and waits 30 epochs. Splitting identities raises marginal cost per fake and draws independent jurors who trace the shared signal across the orchard of linked bonds.
